question: Which public sector bank raised ₹10,000 crore through its maiden green infrastructure bond issuance in March 2026?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bank of Baroda.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Bank of Baroda (BoB) raised ₹10,000 crore via its first-ever green infrastructure bonds on March 6, 2026.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The issuance was split into two tranches: a 7-year maturity bond at 7.74% and a 10-year maturity bond at 7.85% coupon rate.**
 
• **The funds are 100% earmarked for green projects including renewable energy, electric mobility, and green buildings.**
 
• **The bonds received a AAA (stable) rating from top agencies like CRISIL, ICRA, and India Ratings.**
 
• **This is one of the largest green bond tranches issued by an Indian PSU bank to date.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Green Bonds__

 __
 
• Fixed-income instruments specifically designed to support climate-related or environmental projects.
 
 
 
• Bank of Baroda__
 __
 
• Establishment year - 1908
 
• HQ - Vadodara (Corporate Office in Mumbai)
 
• It is India's second-largest public sector bank.
 
 
 
• CRISIL/ICRA__
 __
 
• Credit rating agencies that evaluate the creditworthiness of debt instruments and their issuers.
 
 
 
• Coupon Rate__
 
 
• The annual interest rate paid by the bond issuer to the bondholder.
